# Color Mapper (colormapper.xyz)

> Free color tools for designers, printers, and developers: palettes, gradients, WCAG contrast, Tailwind scales, print gamut checks, and converters between RGB, CMYK, HEX, HSL, and HSV. No account required.

Color Mapper is a static toolkit site. Each page is an interactive tool or guide with copy-ready values (HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSL, HSV) and short educational copy.

## Main pages

- https://colormapper.xyz — Homepage and overview of all tools
- https://colormapper.xyz/tools — Directory of free color tools
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-color — Hub for all color format converters
- https://colormapper.xyz/blog — Articles on color workflows and accessibility

## Color tools

- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes — Color palette generator (harmony schemes, CMYK values, print gamut warnings)
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/complementary — Complementary palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/analogous — Analogous palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/triadic — Triadic palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/split-complementary — Split complementary palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/monochromatic — Monochromatic palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/palettes/tetradic — Tetradic palette generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/gradients — CSS gradient generator (linear, radial, conic)
- https://colormapper.xyz/gradients/linear — Linear CSS gradient generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/gradients/radial — Radial CSS gradient generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/gradients/conic — Conic CSS gradient generator
- https://colormapper.xyz/contrast-checker — WCAG 2.1 color contrast checker (AA and AAA)
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-scale — Tint and shade generator (Tailwind-style 50–950 scale)
- https://colormapper.xyz/palette-from-image — Extract a color palette from an image (in-browser)
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-blindness — Color blindness simulator (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia)
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel — Interactive color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/complementary — Complementary color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/analogous — Analogous color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/triadic — Triadic color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/split-complementary — Split complementary color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/monochromatic — Monochromatic color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/color-wheel/tetradic — Tetradic color wheel
- https://colormapper.xyz/print-gamut — Print gamut checker (screen RGB vs CMYK shift)
- https://colormapper.xyz/compare-colors — Compare two colors (Delta E 2000)
- https://colormapper.xyz/random-color-generator — Random color generator (HEX, five-color palette, two-color CSS linear gradient)

## Color converters

- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-cmyk-to-hex — CMYK to HEX
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-cmyk-to-hsl — CMYK to HSL
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-cmyk-to-rgb — CMYK to RGB
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hex-to-cmyk — HEX to CMYK
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hex-to-hsl — HEX to HSL
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hex-to-hsv — HEX to HSV
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hex-to-rgb — HEX to RGB
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsl-to-cmyk — HSL to CMYK
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsl-to-hex — HSL to HEX
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsl-to-hsv — HSL to HSV
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsl-to-rgb — HSL to RGB
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsv-to-cmyk — HSV to CMYK
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsv-to-hex — HSV to HEX
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsv-to-hsl — HSV to HSL
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-hsv-to-rgb — HSV to RGB
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-rgb-to-cmyk — RGB to CMYK
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-rgb-to-hex — RGB to HEX
- https://colormapper.xyz/convert-rgb-to-hsl — RGB to HSL
